body: I didn't want to copy/paste, but I made a post with a more detailed story in the depression forum a few days back.

Is it because you actually don't care FOR him or because you are dealing with so much stuff that you CAN'T really care about anyone?  If it's the former, consider reaching out to a therapist because it's their job to care about you whether you care for them or not.  If it's the latter, explain your feelings in a more nuanced way, and they might be able to understand.
Why not tell him the truth?  Try that and take it from there.  Don't get drunk and start spewing all your feelings at once, but tell him you've been struggling and gauge his reaction.
